question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word

The worker is known to__ __**__exert__ **himself a lot.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 3)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exert"** means to apply or bring to bear (a force, influence, or quality). It often implies a considerable effort or physical activity. (प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The athlete ***exerted*** all his energy to win the race.
 
 
 
• **"Relax"** means to make or become less tense or anxious; to rest from work or effort. (आराम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, he likes to ***relax*** by watching television.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'exert'** is **'relax'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crouch** (झुकना): To bend down, often on your knees.

 
 
• **Example:** The cat ***crouched*** low, ready to pounce on its prey.
 
 
 
• **Emerge** (उभरना): To come out into view, as from concealment.
 
 
• **Example:** The sun ***emerged*** from behind the clouds.
 
 
 
• **Stress** (तनाव): A state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt a lot of*** stress*** before her final exams.
